preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10,000, inclusive.
The length of the sequence for each test case is between 2 and 300,000, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 3 * 10^5
preconditions.description: The sum of the lengths of all sequences across all test cases does not exceed 300,000.

postconditions.description: The difference between the maximum and minimum values in the sequence is equal to the square root of the sum of all the values in the sequence.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 10^9 for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each integer in the sequence is between 1 and 1,000,000,000, inclusive.
All integers in the sequence are distinct.
